QuestInfo.name: Alex the Runaway
QuestInfo.0: A kid named Alex is calling to you. He looks like a punk, but really, who are you to judge?
QuestInfo.1: Alex lost a keepsake from his mom. See if Mr. Pickall knows anything about an Old Gold Watch.
QuestInfo.2: Mr. Pickall is not only a master of unlocking, but also owns a pawn shop. He probably knows a thing or two about the Old Gold Watch.

0.0: Hey, you got a second? I need some help. See, about a month ago, I ran away from home 'cause my dad's a jerk. Thing is, I kinda ran out of money, and I'm getting tired of #m103000000#...
0.1: I wanna go back home, but only if dad stops being a jerk! So, I wanna send someone to go there and make sure he's cool with me.
0.2: But, um, I also kinda lost an old keepsake mom gave him, and he'll kick me out for sure if I finds out. I need to get it back!

yes.0: I think I lost mom's #bOld Gold Watch#k in the Kerning City Subway, but I can't find it. I even asked that idiot Jake, but he said nothing showed up in the lost-and-found.
yes.1: Would you please go ask Mr. Pickall about it? He knows everything about Kerning City.

no.0: Man, I'll never get to go home...

npc.0: When are you going to ask Mr. Pickall? I gotta find that watch!
